title: Internet Shakespeare Editions (University of Victoria)
institution: Internet Shakespeare Editions Inc., University of Victoria (founder Michael Best)
author: William Shakespeare
license_note: Free to read; texts are copyright of the editors (or of the ISE for unedited texts) and may be used for educational non-profit purposes.
notes: Open-access site with diplomatic old-spelling transcriptions of all 37 plays and the poems (quarto and folio versions) and, for 22 plays and most poems, modern-spelling editions prepared for the web, with facsimiles, performance and 'Life and Times' sections. The home page was last modified on 8 December 2022 and other pages date from 2015-2018 ('Accessed on 2019-01-11'); the publisher's follow-up work is on the Linked Early Modern Drama Online platform (lemdo.uvic.ca), which is a separate resource. This is the same resource as the old address http://internetshakespeare.uvic.ca/ (candidate 346). The counts cover the 67 old-spelling quarto and folio witnesses listed on the Texts index, not the modern-spelling editions. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
